Code as Policies: LLMs re-compose API calls into policy code with loops/feedback on real robots; hierarchical code generation by recursively defining functions.
SkillWeaver 2025: agents synthesizing skills as APIs gain 31.8% (WebArena) / 39.8% (real sites); skills transfer to weaker agents up to 54.3%.

Mindcraft library folder: skills.js (hand-written), skill_library.js (retrieval), world.js, lockdown.js.

Mindcraft coder.js: !newAction generates JS, lint + skill-name checks, interrupt guards injected, executed in a restricted SES-style compartment — the code-skill escape hatch shipped beside modes.
